title: Foundry profile config v1
description: docs/PLAN.md Task 21 (FND-02): versioned shape of profiles.config. schema_version pins this document to a specific version of this schema so future revisions can be introduced without silently breaking profiles saved under an earlier version.

schema_version.description: Config schema version. Must equal 1 for this schema; profile.Validate rejects any other value with a clear error rather than accepting an unknown shape.

max_usd.description: Maximum USD spend this profile authorizes.
